caption: The drawing shows a square, woven container with a lid, crafted from natural materials that appear to be plant fibers and strips of bark or reed. The majority of the basket is composed of interlaced, straw-like fibers in various shades of tan, ochre, and brown, which create a textured, patterned effect. The front edge, rim, and part of the base are made up of wider, smoother, and shinier brown strips, giving the lower half of the basket a different texture and color. The lid of the container rests slightly open, revealing a glimpse of a dark black interior surface as well as the continuation of the woven fibers inside. A small, looped handle, also made from plant material and matching the outer fiber’s color, is located at the top center of the lid. The composition is centered on a white background and outlined by a thin, rectangular, reddish-brown border. The artist's signature and a date or reference number are visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Sewing Basket
